propositions: Jira-family-general symbols (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary, status/priority maps) are currently scattered across adapters/jira/ but must be extracted into a new shared layer at adapters/jira_family/ to serve multiple Jira-family backends while respecting ADR 0035 seam rules.

Identity, pure classifier logic, and most sanitizers move wholesale; sanitizers with pinned-module dependencies (ADF, comment limits) relocate contract-parameterized; the status/priority map literals must unify into a single definition to eliminate existing drift (the 'deleted' key disagreement between jira_fields.py and outbound_fields.py).

The extraction must not invert dependency direction: location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) stay in adapters/jira/ and remain the sole load sites; jira_family/ imports from neither sibling adapter nor from pinned modules, only receives injected contracts.

All internal importers and mock.patch targets must be re-pointed atomically in the same change with no re-export shims left behind; imports into pinned modules must use absolute paths (never relative) because those modules load via spec_from_file_location with no package context.

The deliberate behavior change (deleted ticket transitions now resolve to 'Done' instead of invalid 'Deleted') must be declared and pinned with a test; all other observable behavior must remain identical and verified by J1's unmodified characterization oracles.

The acli*.py transport modules change only in import statements (verified by git diff -U0), preserving all logic; RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES remains defined in adapters/jira/probe as Cloud's configured value and is passed as a required keyword-only parameter to the relocated classifier.
